turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you gave him a zero?
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Setting the grade aside. No. Was he heard first?
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
I'm not on your side of this desk. The zero comes off, and I want an apology for how he found out.
